QuestInfo.name: The Gate at Cloud Park
QuestInfo.0: It seems the invitation wasn't from Spiruna, but Starling instead. What is she up to?
QuestInfo.1: Go to #r#m200080000##k and see if there's another one of those gates you found at the Excavation Site.
QuestInfo.2: You found another blue gate at #m200080000#, where you met Lora.

0.0: Since you're here, perhaps you'll lend an old woman your ear? It was simply horrible. The other day, Pixies attacked my assistant and I while we were on a stroll!\r\n#L0##bWait, so you really didn't invite anyone here? (Was this a trick?!)#l\n#k
0.1: How rude! Don't interrupt me! Anyway, the Tower of Goddess and that nasty Papa Pixie had something to do with this, I'm sure of it!\r\n#L0##b(Starling's behind this. I just know it!) Yes, yes, that's really very interesting.#l\n#k
0.2: I was going to give Papa Pixie a piece of my mind, but on my way through #m200080000#, I saw a strange blue gate. And all around the gate, the Pixies were gibbering and jabbering and raising all kinds of ruckus! I ran straight home, I did, and I haven't set foot outside since.\r\n#L0##bWait, what's this about a gate?#l\n#k
0.3: Dreadful thing. Would you be willing to look into it for me?

yes.0: Oh, good. It would be nice to be able to go for a walk again without worrying that I'll get mugged by Pixies.

no.0: You're just as bad as the Pixies!

1.0: You're the one Starling mentioned, aren't you?

npc.0: Check out the blue gate in #m200080000#. It seems very suspicious...
